findings.description: Three dialogs stack on first paint — the privacy-policy popup, the geolocation modal ("YES, STAY ON UNITED STATES / NO, GO TO THE CANADA SITE") and the OneTrust banner — and a div.zds-backdrop keeps intercepting clicks after the first one is closed. Visitors whose IP country differs from the site country get the extra geolocation modal.
findings.proposed_fix: Show at most one dialog on first paint; remove div.zds-backdrop when its dialog closes; give .geolocation-modal a single default action and role="dialog" with aria-labelledby.

findings.description: On the search results grid every tile exposes an unlabelled button.product-add-to-cart__button (aria-label "Open size selector", no visible text) and an anchor with no text; a DOM-driven agent has only the + button to act on and opens a size list instead of the product. A vision agent reads the product name under the photo and clicks it.
findings.proposed_fix: Give the tile anchor (a[data-qa-action="product-click"]) the product name as link text or aria-label, and change button.product-add-to-cart__button to visible text "Select size".

findings.description: Picking a size fires POST /us/en/shop/cart/add?ajax=true which the Akamai bot gate answers with 403; the page shows no error, the bag counter stays 0 and /us/en/shop/cart reads YOUR BAG IS EMPTY. Both engines hit it; no journey can reach checkout.
findings.proposed_fix: Apply the bot rule once at page level and let sessions that passed it call /shop/cart/add, or surface the 403 as a visible error on button[data-qa-action="add-to-cart"] instead of failing silently.

findings.description: On the mobile product page the ADD button sits under a swipeable DESCRIPTION / COLOR / CONTENTS / MEASUREMENTS tab carousel and behind the dialog backdrop; the first tap on button.product-detail-cart-buttons__button timed out at 30 s. On desktop the same button responds once the dialogs are closed.
findings.proposed_fix: Pin the ADD / size control above the tab carousel on mobile and make it a sticky bar; do not render the backdrop over it.
